# Template — Licensed Deployment & API Service-Level Agreement

> ⚠️ **Template only**, not legal advice. Prices are placeholders to validate with pilot partners.

**Customer:** `[organisation]` · **Provider:** AgriSphere (maintainer) · **Date:** `[date]`

## 1. Service
- White-label assistant (name/colours per brand kit) on chosen channels: Web/PWA `[✓/✗]`,
  WhatsApp `[✓/✗]`, Messenger `[✓/✗]`, Telegram `[✓/✗]`.
- Shared AgriSphere knowledge base + `[N]` custom knowledge packs (customer content converted
  into audited topics) + marketplace/programme access where agreed.
- Learning-queue review: `[weekly / monthly]` human review of unanswered questions & flagged
  answers by provider or customer's nominated agronomist (approval mode configurable).
- Uptime target: 99.5% monthly (excludes scheduled maintenance and platform outages);
  provider credits `[X]`% of monthly fee if missed — measured on `/healthz`.

## 2. Fees (validate with pilots)
- Setup: `[P …]` (channels activation incl. Meta verification support, branding, custom packs).
- Monthly: `[P …]` incl. `[N]` messages/mo; overage `[P …/1k]`. Enterprise/annual discounts `[X]%`.
- Optional: dedicated support `[hours/mo]`, SLA with response times (next-business-day standard).
- Invoicing: monthly in arrears, 14-day terms. Freeze/suspend after 30 days overdue with notice.

## 3. Customer duties
- Provide truthful content for knowledge packs; lawful use only; no resale without written consent.
- Keep API tokens secret; tokens rotate on request/breach. Customer is responsible for its users'
  data protection notices (template available) and for emergency/extension contacts in its territory.

## 4. Data & privacy
- Provider processes: chat texts (session-scoped), feedback, learning queue, anonymised stats.
- **No sale of personal data. No ads on the service.** Aggregated anonymised insights may be used
  to improve the knowledge base; customer may opt out of insight sharing.
- Deletion: users may request deletion; customer may request full workspace deletion within 30 days.
- Optional LLM mode: disclosure required; may be disabled at customer request (`ENABLE_LLM=false`).

## 5. Intellectual property
- AgriSphere code: GPL-3.0 (open source). Customer brand & content remain customer's.
- Custom knowledge packs: jointly owned per contribution terms; provider may genericise
  non-confidential parts into the public knowledge base after `[12]` months.

## 6. Liability
- Provider liability capped at fees paid in the prior 3 months; no liability for indirect loss.
- Service provides decision support, not professional advice; disclaimers remain displayed.

## 7. Term & exit
- Initial `[12]` months, auto-renew monthly thereafter; 30-day written notice; exit data export
  (learned lessons in CSV/JSON) provided within 14 days.
